title: Yeah I helped my students install it turning off "s-mode" but there isn't much need to throw shade on @firefox by calling it slower and less secure...
summary: Yeah I helped my students install it turning off "s-mode" but there isn't much need to throw shade on @firefox by calling it slower and less secure...and to a normal consumer "s-mode" means nothing. It isn't a @firefox problem, its shady UX from @microsoft
